title: DashboardPanelStatusItem
description: One Output panel's status on a dashboard (HEL-1786). `lastRunAt` is the bound pipeline's last run time (null when it has never run); `runStatus` is `succeeded`, `failed` or null; `dataUpdatedAt` is when the panel's latest stored data was captured (the Output's newest history point, committed with the rows; null when it has none) and is the client's run-finish refresh trigger; `invalid` is true when an error-severity assertion on the Output's own step failed on the pipeline's latest non-dry run. Carries no pipeline, step, run, Output or user id and no error text.
